name: HR Policy Squad Orchestrator
description: Orchestrator that decomposes an employee HR question, delegates to a policy-retrieval worker and an eligibility-calculation worker, and synthesises one answer.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped token; the leave-only scope is denied grade-band lookups (same scoping as the Week 9 gateway).

skills.name: HR policy lookup
skills.description: Answer a policy question from the HR policy PDFs with source file citations; refuses when the documents do not contain the answer.
examples: What are the core work hours?

skills.name: Leave eligibility check
skills.description: Check whether a specific employee qualifies for a leave type using HRIS grade band and accrued balance. Needs an employee ID; asks for the grade band if HRIS cannot supply it.
examples: Can EMP001 take 12 days of annual leave?
